home.title: Bubamara Counselling — For a life you love!
home.description: Personal development and quality of life coaching. Sara Spence, M.A. Psych., certified life coach.
home.introHeading: Personal Development & Quality of Life Coaching
home.introP1: The world we live in has changed drastically over the past few decades and achieving the quality of life we want is becoming increasingly challenging. Personal development is becoming more important than ever if we want to reach our full potential. On that path, all of us sometimes need support. That may involve “small” things, such as building healthier habits and managing stress, or more significant and “bigger” challenges, such as life transitions, difficulties, and major changes.
home.introP2: My aim is to support you on your path of self-discovery and help you grow into a person living an authentic and fulfilled life. Within a space of trust, safety, and complete respect for your individuality, my goal is to help you achieve what matters most to you.
home.aboutP1: I am Sara Spence, a psychologist and life coach. Through my own experience of facing challenging life situations, I have learned how to turn obstacles into opportunities for growth and to find myself again in new circumstances.
home.aboutP2: My main goal is to use all the knowledge, experience and methods I have refined to support you in reaching your fullest potential and building a life you love living.

Building habits that support health and wellbeing
card2Items: Support during challenging life events and changes

about.title: About me — Bubamara Counselling
about.description: Sara Spence, M.A. Psych. and certified life coach. Learn more about my approach and education.
about.heading: About me
about.bioP1: I am Sara Spence, a psychologist and life coach. Throughout my life, I have faced many challenges and obstacles that shaped me into the person I am today. I have moved to another country, lost my husband to a heart attack in early 2017, went through my mother’s illness and passing, and moved countries again to return to Croatia and start anew. To navigate these challenges and changes, I had to learn to see obstacles as opportunities for growth. I needed to reconnect with myself (my needs and emotions) and rebuild my life from the ground up in completely new circumstances - twice.
about.bioP2: Learning to love myself, become my own best friend, parent, and support system was the hardest challenge, but also the greatest gift I could have given myself. Through my personal journey, I discovered the value of self-development and recognized the positive impact it has on, not just myself, but the people around me as well.
about.bioP3: Now I want to use all the knowledge and experience I have gained to support you in reaching your potential and creating a life you love living. At the core of my work are understanding, respect, and the creation of a safe space for exploration and growth. I deeply believe that every person is capable of change and that we ourselves are our greatest resource. Even with that, we sometimes need support. That is why I do not offer ready-made solutions — instead, I help you find the ones that are right for you. I adapt my approach and methods to your unique needs and characteristics, whether through evidence-based practices or through approaches that integrate spirituality with science.

spiritual.heading: Support in Spiritual & Energetic Work
spiritual.intro: In recent decades, science has begun to validate concepts that were once considered purely spiritual. Have you ever wondered:
items: What does enlightenment really mean? How do we achieve it?
How can I raise my vibrational frequency fully and permanently?
What exactly is manifestation? What are the steps and how do I do it?
How do I use affirmations? I try to think positively, but nothing changes.
Meditation doesn’t work for me — what should I do instead?
I absorb and feel other people’s emotions very strongly. How do I protect myself?
What exactly is the ego and why does it sometimes become so active?
How do I develop my intuition? It seems to work sometimes, and sometimes not.
Are the energies I work with (or encounter) positive? How can I tell the difference?
spiritual.outro: These are just some of the questions that may arise on a spiritual development journey. If you feel “stuck” at any point, I am here to help. Through my own experience and practices, I have learned to combine “intangible” spiritual concepts with practical techniques and tools that I would be happy to share with you. We often need very little in order to continue on our own. So, whether we do one session or more, it will depend entirely on your needs and preferences.

reiki.heading: Energy healing - Reiki Holy Fire III
reiki.intro: Reiki Holy Fire III is a gentle yet remarkably powerful form of energy healing, renowned for its deeply cleansing, nurturing and transformative qualities. It works by activating the body’s natural ability to return to a state of balance, release tension, and cultivate a deeper sense of inner peace. It helps us reconnect with our inner strength, clarity and sense of direction—gently and always in alignment with our own rhythm. It may support you if you are:
items: looking for emotional relief, grounding or calm
feeling overwhelmed, stressed or energetically depleted
wanting to reconnect with yourself and your intuition
going through life transitions or healing processes
needing support in releasing old patterns or emotional blocks
wanting to raise your vibration and feel more aligned
reiki.outro: Because Reiki is an intelligent energy in its own right, it always works in whatever way serves you best in that exact moment. It can help you feel more relaxed and restored, or bring profound shifts right in the areas where you are ready for change.

relax.heading: Relaxation Groups
relax.p1: Research shows that regular practice of relaxation techniques reduces the impact of stress and increases focus, calm and a sense of wellbeing. It also helps us notice what is happening within us more easily, which can be key to navigating various situations and achieving our goals (even if that goal is "just" feeling okay).
relax.p2: These groups are designed to help you carve out time for yourself, and to learn and practice a variety of relaxation techniques. Each session's guided relaxation may look a little different, yet its core aim will always remain the same: soothing the nervous system, releasing tension, and quieting the mind. In doing so, we bring our system back to the "here and now", giving it a much-needed break from everyday life.
relax.sessionsIntro: Sessions take place online, last approximately 30 minutes, and consist of:
sessionItems: a brief intro and settling in
a closing debrief with space for questions and comments
relax.needHeading: What do you need to take part?
needItems: a device capable of running Google Meet
a quiet space and uninterrupted time where you can truly unwind
no prior knowledge or experience needed – all practices are fully guided so you can deeply relax and surrender to the experience
relax.closing: Ready to do something good for yourself—and, in turn, for everyone around you?

faq.title: FAQ — Bubamara Counselling
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about counselling, Reiki treatments, sessions and prices. Everything you need to know.
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before taking the first step

q1.q: How do I know if this is right for me?
q1.intro: You’re in the right place if:
items: You feel you can or want to do more, but don’t know what or how
You want to change careers or find your life purpose
You’re dealing with stress, exhaustion, overwhelm, or difficulty relaxing
You want to manage your emotions more effectively
You have goals but aren’t sure how to reach them
You know what you need, but struggle to get started
You’re going through a challenging period and need support
You want to deepen your self-understanding
You want to learn to love and appreciate yourself more
q1.outro: If your answer to any of these is "yes", we can explore the answers together.

q2.q: What happens if I decide to reach out?
answer: First of all — congratulations on your courage! To get started, fill out the contact form or email me at sara.spence@bubamarasavjetovanje.hr. Please include a short info on your reasons for contacting me with any additional notes if needed (e.g., preferred time or format of sessions).
Once I receive your message, I will contact you to arrange the session time and format.

q3.q: What do sessions look like and how often do they take place?
answer: Sessions can be held online or in person, in Croatian or English, depending on your preferences.
Sessions usually last 50 minutes, and extended sessions (90–100 minutes) can be arranged if needed.
The frequency of sessions varies. Ideally, sessions are regular (e.g., weekly or bi-weekly), as consistency supports the change process by providing structure and continuity.

Reiki sessions are conducted exclusively remotely (online). Each session lasts 25–35 minutes. During the session, you should remain awake and either lying down or sitting comfortably, in your own space, free of distractions.

q4.q: What can I expect from Sara and the process?
answer: Because I place great importance on “humanity,” my core values include compassion, respect, and appreciation for each person’s unique characteristics, needs, desires, and circumstances. You can expect me to do everything I can to ensure you feel seen, acknowledged, and free to express whatever is important to you in that moment. You can also expect occasional questions, exercises, and feedback, depending on the situation. These are invitations to broaden your perspective, discover new creative solutions, and achieve meaningful change.

During Reiki sessions, you may experience physical sensations, emotions or insights — or nothing at all. Reiki is gentle yet highly intelligent and powerful, and its effects depend entirely on what is best for you at that moment.

q5.q: How quickly can I expect results?
answer: The pace of progress depends on your specific goal and situation. The number of sessions may range from just one to many.
The number of Reiki sessions never exceeds 10 without a longer break in between.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Bubamara Counselling
privacy.description: Privacy Policy — how Bubamara savjetovanje collects, processes and protects your personal data.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This Privacy Policy explains how Bubamara savjetovanje, Slavka Kolara 10, Velika Gorica, VAT/OIB 37702159237 collects, processes and protects your personal data when you visit the website bubamarasavjetovanje.hr or contact me.
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is of utmost importance to me. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully to learn which data is collected and for what purposes it is used.
privacy.s1p1: Via the website, only personal data that you voluntarily provide through the contact form or direct email is collected: full name, email address, phone number, and the content of the message/inquiry you submit.
privacy.s1p2: Since my website does not use tracking cookies or web analytics tools, technical browsing data is not automatically collected.
privacy.s2h: 2. Purpose and legal basis for processing data
privacy.s2intro: Your personal data is collected and processed for the following purposes:
s2items: Responding to your inquiries: When you contact me with an inquiry about the services I offer, I process your data in order to reply to your inquiry and agree on next steps (based on taking pre-contractual steps at your request).
Execution of service and contract: If you become my client, I use your data to perform the services and maintain business records (in compliance with statutory invoicing obligations).
privacy.s3h: 3. How long is your data retained?
s3items: Inquiries without subsequent collaboration: Data submitted via the contact form that does not result in the provision of a service is retained for a maximum of 12 months from the last communication, after which it is deleted.
Client data (accounting documentation): Data on performed services and issued invoices are retained for the statutory period prescribed by accounting and tax regulations (typically 11 years).
privacy.s4h: 4. Who has access to your data?
privacy.s4p: Your personal data is strictly confidential. It is not sold, rented or shared with third parties, except with competent state authorities in situations where this is explicitly required by law.
privacy.s5p: Appropriate technical and organisational security measures are implemented to prevent accidental or unlawful loss, destruction, unauthorised access or modification of your personal data.
privacy.s6intro: At any time, you have the right to:
s6items: Access to data: Request confirmation as to whether your data is being processed and access to the same.
Rectification and completion: Request the correction of inaccurate data.
Erasure ("right to be forgotten"): Request the erasure of your personal data if they are no longer necessary for the purpose for which they were collected.
Objection: Object to the processing of data.
privacy.s6p: You may exercise all your rights by sending a request to the email address: sara.spence@bubamarasavjetovanje.hr.
privacy.s7p: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to remain compliant with legislative or business changes. We recommend checking this page from time to time.
